newsitem.title: UK: UK M0 rises to s/a 25.246 bln stg, week to April 9.
newsitem.headline: UK M0 rises to s/a 25.246 bln stg, week to April 9.

text.p: British M0 money supply rose to a provisional seasonally adjusted 25.246 billion stg in the week to April 9 from 25.153 billion the previous week, the Bank of England said on Monday.
On an unadjusted basis M0 dipped to 24.970 billion stg from 25.560 the previous week.
Notes and coins in circulation rose to 25.114 from 25.113 billion stg on a seasonally adjusted basis. Unadjusted notes and coins fell to 24.838 billion stg from 25.520 billion stg.
